title: Stage 4, COVID Boosters, Kids' Vax Plans
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   Austin/Travis County shifts to COVID-19 Stage 4 due to declining cases and hospitalizations, though masking is still recommended indoors and for unvaccinated individuals.
*   Pfizer COVID-19 booster shots are now available for eligible groups, including those 65+, individuals with high-risk medical conditions, and certain front-line workers.
*   Officials are preparing for COVID-19 vaccination of children under 12 once approved, with a focus on school-based clinics and continued efforts to reach underserved communities.
*   Data shows masking significantly reduces COVID-19 spread in schools, and Austin hospitals are increasingly caring for COVID patients from surrounding counties with lower vaccination rates.
